summary.name: Digistorm
summary.one_liner: Digistorm is an educational real-time interaction tool by La Digitale for running live surveys, brainstorms, word clouds and quizzes in classrooms or remote sessions.
use_cases: running live polls in a classroom
collecting ideas in a brainstorm session
generating a word cloud from audience input
engaging participants in remote team meetings
summary.what_it_does: Digistorm lets users create and animate live surveys, brainstorms, word clouds, and quizzes. Activities can be combined into sequences. The page describes use in the classroom, virtual classroom, or remote work. The listing on awesome-selfhosted indicates it is under the AGPL-3.0 license, built with Node.js, with documentation in French and a demo and source code available. The page text itself is brief and does not detail specific features beyond these activity types.
notable: Combines surveys, brainstorms, word clouds and quizzes into sequences
Designed for education and remote work
Listed on awesome-selfhosted with AGPL-3.0 license and Node.js source
caveats: Page text is brief; pricing not stated on the page
